claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Proterial's HRE-saving output is shown to be pilot-scale only or discontinued in future disclosures.
claims.statement: Proterial (NEOMAX inventor lineage, ex-Hitachi Metals) states it has succeeded in developing and mass-producing heavy-rare-earth-saving NdFeB material (minimizing Dy/Tb), with DDMagic Dy vapor deposition and diffusion as its named technology. Vendor self-report; corroborates that GBD-class HRE-saving production is commercialized in Japan as well as China.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public vendor page; URL and short excerpts.
source_doc.title: Proterial — Nd-Fe-B Magnets NEOMAX (heavy rare earth-saving mass production)

sources.quote: We have succeeded in developing and mass-producing the high-performance, heavy rare earth-saving material, which minimizes the amount of heavy rare earth elements added, such as dysprosium (Dy) and terbium (Tb).
We were the pioneers to develop and mass-produce NEOMAX®, a rare earth sintered magnet whose main components are neodymium (Nd), iron (Fe), and boron (B).
